reason: historical routes contain 17 or 18 completed stops, but only 15 had completed before the five frozen PMFS source updates and are scientifically authorised for CBPE

selection.inputs: pose timestamps, complete-stop index sets and the five frozen source-update timestamps only; measured gas is prohibited when selecting support
selection.visible_prefixes: for source update j, a stop is visible only when its 80th pose sample time is no later than that update timestamp
selection.block_definition: block j is exactly the three newly visible original-schedule stop indices at update j, in original schedule order
selection.excluded: every completed stop outside the union of the five verified visible prefixes, including the final 2 or 3 post-update stops
prohibited: blindly slicing the first 15 stops without verifying timestamps
using measured hit/miss or truth to select stops
including post-fifth-update stops in Q, premise, score or controls
